messages:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp hit a weird failure: rerank scores are garbage after we switched to the new embed endpoint. seems like shape mismatch + duplicate items. paste of error: `ValueError: vector length 1536 != expected 1024`

maya: ugh. did the model change? which SDK and language?

alex: Python SDK 0.8.2 in the sampleapp. logs show API returning embeddings length 1536. sampleapp was authored expecting 1024 (old model). But the Go helper used by our retriever library is trimming to 1024 silently which leads to truncated vectors and wrong rerank order.

sam: can you drop the raw responses? maybe response field name differs? we've seen `embedding` vs `embeddings` vs `vector` before.

alex: yep. raw response (redacted):
```json
{"id":"abc","embedding":[0.001,0.002,...(1536 numbers)...],"model":"open-lite-1536"}
```
Go SDK response that's parsed by our helper:
```json
{"id":"abc","vectors":[0.001,0.002,...(1024 numbers)...]}
```
So two problems: field name diff + length diff.

jun: interesting. where's the batch helper involved?

alex: our batching helper (batcher.go / batcher.py) has a pad/truncate option. In Go it defaults to truncate to expected_dim when auth retry kicks in and we re-assemble batches. The Python helper default is to return raw. So under retry, Go path truncates on re-merge; Python double-calls produce duplicates.

maya: that explains why some queries had duplicated results (retry produced same vector again) and others had misordered ranks (truncated vectors).

sam: what about auth? were there 401s or token refresh logs?

alex: yes — sequence: 401 -> token refresh -> retry (same request id). ci-bot captured it:
```text
ci-bot: [1719000002] 401 Unauthorized for /v1/embeddings
ci-bot: [1719000003] token refresh success
ci-bot: [1719000004] retry request id=xyz status=200
```
The retry merged into existing batch in Go and triggered truncate path. Python retried as separate call which resulted in duplicate vector rows inserted into DB before dedupe.

jun: here's a quick mitigation: 1) make batcher preserve raw dims and error if dimension != expected_dim (fail-fast), 2) ensure retry path tags requests with an idempotency key and do not re-merge partial batches during retry, 3) canonicalize response field names in SDKs.

maya: agreed. can we ship a small fix in the sampleapp and an SDK patch? I can do the Python change to validate dims and add idempotency header. sam can handle Go default behaviour.

sam: yep I'll change Go batcher: keep vector bytes until validation step, and on retry avoid truncation; also map `vectors` -> `embedding` for parity. will open PR.

alex: thanks. quick workaround for teams: set explicit `expected_embedding_dim` in sampleapp config and enable `strict_vector_validation=true` in batch helper. That will make the app fail loudly instead of silently corrupting rerank.

jun: created follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4287 — label devex/embeddings. I'll add test cases (python+go) that validate field name permutations and dim mismatch.

ci-bot: [1719000038] deploy-check passed for branch alex/embed-dim-check (CI: 5/5).

maya: thanks all. we'll include a note in the onboarding guide about expected dims + SDK parity quirks and link the sampleapp patch. :thumbsup:

alex: putting a short snippet we recommend teams use in the meantime:
```python
# validate embeddings from API
resp = client.embeddings.create(...)
vec = resp[\"embedding\"] if \"embedding\" in resp else resp.get(\"vectors\")
if len(vec) != CONFIG.EXPECTED_DIM:
    raise RuntimeError(f\"embedding dim {len(vec)} != {CONFIG.EXPECTED_DIM}\")
# use idempotency key on retry
client.headers.update({\"Idempotency-Key\": request_id})
```

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/212 (batcher: preserve_dims + map vectors->embedding).

maya: I'll update sampleapp and docs. filing a short postmortem note in the onboarding repo.

alex: resolved for now, moving to follow-up. thanks everyone! :rocket:
